items.t: Enbridge: The Moat Is Holding, But Growth Is Stalling (Rating Downgrade)
items.sum: Analyst rates Enbridge a Buy: its Mainline moat holds, and gas and utilities support growth; shares trade at 11.6x 2026 DCF/share guidance.

items.t: Energy Transfer vs. Enbridge: Which High-Yield Pipeline Stock Could Make You Richer Over the Next 10 Years?
items.sum: Both pipeline companies offer attractive dividends and long-term growth opportunities, but one could make you richer over the next decade.

items.t: Enbridge (TSX:ENB) Stock Looks About Right As Acquisition Activity Builds
items.sum: Enbridge has delivered sizeable long term gains for shareholders, and fresh deal activity plus government backed projects have kept the story in the headlines. The live question is whether that share price now lines up with what the business is earning. Over the past 5 years, the stock has returned 85.2%, which puts real pressure on the current earnings multiple to carry that track record forward.

items.t: Enbridge (TSX:ENB) Gets Government Backing For Woodfibre LNG Growth Plans
items.sum: Enbridge (TSX:ENB) received a major Canadian government investment for its Woodfibre LNG project, supporting higher capacity and potential expansion. The funding targets infrastructure at the Woodfibre LNG site, aiming to increase liquefaction capability and related export facilities. Project partners are assessing how the new capital could shape timelines, contracting plans and future LNG output

items.t: VDY:CA: A Good Canadian Financials And O&G-Heavy ETF, But See If It Fits
items.sum: Analyst rates VDY:CA a Hold: with 58.8% in financials and 29.3% in energy, portfolio fit matters more than past performance.

items.t: Evers & Sons Joins 60 Fellow INGAA Foundation Members in Urging Congress to Pass the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act
items.sum: HOUSTON, November 19, 2026--Evers & Sons Inc. has joined 60 fellow INGAA Foundation member companies in urging Congress to enact the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (S. 5653) before the end of the year.
